[[syntax trees at end of                     typer]] // SameOwnerMembers.scala
package <empty> {
  class Calculator() extends Object() {
    val bias: Int = 2
    def adjust(x: Int): Int = x + this.bias
    def lifted: Int => Int = (x: Int) => this.adjust(x)
    def explicit: Int => Int = (x: Int) => this.adjust(x)
    def withBias: Int => Int = (x: Int) => x + this.bias
  }
  trait Adapter() extends Object {
    def apply(x: Int): Int
    def lifted: Int => Int = (x: Int) => this.apply(x)
  }
}
